items.title: Dan Morgenstern — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Ken Kimery is mentioned only in the interviewer's introductory remarks as the recording engineer ('Ken Kimery is presiding at the technical aspects'). The interviewee does not mention Ken Kimery in his responses.

ctx.x: Interviewer: Ed Berger with recording engineer Ken Kimery Description: Transcript, 83 pp.

It’s March 28th, 2007. I’m Ed Berger. I’m here at the Institute of Jazz Studies in Newark interviewing my good friend and colleague Dan Morgenstern. Ken Kimery is presiding at the technical aspects. This is for the Smithsonian Oral History Project. Dan, we want to begin the inquisition with your earliest memories, but first, for the record, could you state your full name and your birth date and place?
